MODE_OVERLAY: See-through overlay on top of the desktop.
MODE_OFFSCREEN: No window, you read the pixels.
WINDOW_RESIZABLE: Window flag: the user can resize it.
WINDOW_ON_TOP: Window flag: stays on top of other windows.
EAGAIN: Error code: not ready, try again.
CAP_HIDE_SELF: Capability: keeping our overlay out of grabs.
CAP_GRAB: Capability: grabbing focus and the pointer.
DOWN: Event type: a mouse button went down.
UP: Event type: a mouse button went up.
KEY: Event type: a key was pressed.
HOTKEY: Event type: a registered hotkey fired.
CONTROL: Event type: a line came in on the control fifo.
QUIT: Event type: the session is quitting.
CLOSE: Event type: window close button, alt-f4 or cmd-w. The app decides.
FOCUS: Event type: focus changed, id is 1 when gained and 0 when lost.
DROP: Event type: a file was dropped on the window, see Event.path.
TEXT: Event type: an ime, dead key or compose finished some text.
PREEDIT: Event type: the text being composed changed. Empty means composing ended.
CURSOR_RESIZE_EW: Cursor shape: resize left and right.
CURSOR_RESIZE_NS: Cursor shape: resize up and down.
CURSOR_RESIZE_NWSE: Cursor shape: resize top left to bottom right.
CURSOR_RESIZE_NESW: Cursor shape: resize top right to bottom left.
K_F1: Key code for F1. F2 to F11 follow in order.
FMT_BGRA_PREMUL: Byte order for frameCopy: B,G,R,A premultiplied.
FMT_RGBA_PREMUL: Byte order for frameCopy: R,G,B,A premultiplied.
FMT_BGRA: Byte order for frameCopy: B,G,R,A, unpremultiplied for you.
FMT_RGBA: Byte order for frameCopy: R,G,B,A, unpremultiplied for you.
DIR_AUTO: Text direction from the first strong letter of each line.
ICON_COUNT: How many icon slots there are.
WIN_MOVE: Window flag: can be dragged by its title.
WIN_CLOSE: Window flag: shows a close button.
INPUT_READONLY: Input flag: can be selected but not edited.
INPUT_NO_SELECT_ON_FOCUS: Input flag: dont select everything on focus.
APP_TITLEBAR: App flag: draw a title bar.
APP_MENUBAR: App flag: reserve room for a menu bar.
APP_STATUSBAR: App flag: reserve room for a status bar.
APP_NO_PAD: App flag: no padding around the content.
EDIT_LINE_NUMBERS: Text edit flag: show line numbers.
EDIT_WRAP: Text edit flag: wrap long lines.
TABLE_SORTABLE: Table flag: columns can be sorted by clicking the header.
TABLE_RESIZABLE: Table flag: columns can be resized.
